description: This file defines a PHP class CustomField within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class handles event-driven actions related to custom fields, specifically adding tasks to regenerate customer group data whenever custom fields are added, edited, or deleted. It interacts with models for tasks and custom fields to trigger these updates on specific event hooks.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Handles event hooks for custom field operations such as add, edit, and delete, by scheduling corresponding tasks to update customer group data.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Triggered after adding a custom field; schedules a task to update customer group info based on the new custom field data.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Triggered after editing a custom field; schedules tasks to update customer group info based on the modified custom field.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Triggered after deleting a custom field; schedules tasks to update customer group info to reflect the deletion.

search-terms: custom field add edit delete hooks
